record_type_quote: We conducted a replication of the original Schachter (1951) deviation-rejection study.

targets.title: Deviation, rejection and communication.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a replication of the original Schachter (1951) deviation-rejection study.
targets.outcome_quote:
To conclude, our current study replicated the
primary finding in Schachter’s original deviation-rejection
(the vote outcome), albeit with a smaller effect size. Of
his other two dependent variables, we failed to replicate
the committee assignment variable, but our data trend supported his original findings for communication patterns.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion confirms the vote outcome and communication pattern while explicitly reporting failure on committee assignments. Confirming the main effect alone is not a verdict that the whole replication succeeded.

reasoning: Completed new-sample experiment directly targets the published 1951 paper. The 1950 dissertation supplies procedural detail and earlier replications are background, not targets.
